examples.title: Rainbow
examples.description: A seven-colour rainbow wave painted on the 80-column screen with CHAR and COLOR; BASIC 7.0's line-drawing commands only reach the 40-column chip, which this exhibit does not show.

examples.title: Prime Factors
examples.description: Type a whole number and a BASIC 7.0 DO WHILE loop breaks it into its prime factors; 0 stops.

examples.title: Letter Hunt
examples.description: Ten letters appear one at a time in random places; type each as soon as you see it, against the clock.

manuals.title: Commodore 128 System Guide
manuals.note: The user's guide that came with the machine, with the complete BASIC 7.0 reference. PDF scan.

manuals.title: Commodore 128 Programmer's Reference Guide (1986)
manuals.note: BASIC 7.0, the memory map, the VDC and machine code in depth. Scan at the Internet Archive.
